claude.sample_unit: emergency presentations (133,814 training/validation; 455,496 rolling temporal testing)

links.outcome: Discrimination and daily bed error with periodic retraining versus base model over 2018-2023
links.effect: Base model mean AUROC 0.875, bed error 7.42/day; retrained quarterly and half-yearly AUROC 0.892 and 0.893, bed error 4.02 and 4.48 beds per day.
links.quote: Retrained models demonstrated improved discrimination (mean AUROC 0.892 and 0.893) and reduced bed error (4.02 and 4.48 beds per day) for quarterly and half-yearly retraining, respectively, with similar calibration and classification performance.

links.outcome: Covariate and concept drift and calibration degradation over the six-year testing period
links.effect: Substantial drift between training and testing data and across the testing period; covariate drift degraded calibration but not discrimination.
links.quote: Substantial drift was observed both between training and testing datasets and across the six-year testing period.

links.outcome: Model performance with periodic retraining versus static base model over time
links.effect: Retraining improved mean AUROC (0.875 to 0.892/0.893), reduced bed error, and reduced calibration concept drift.
links.quote: Simple retraining improved discrimination and reduced calibration concept drift, underscoring the importance of retraining to address drift for temporal model deployment.

links.outcome: Calibration and discrimination under covariate drift
links.effect: Calibration degraded while discrimination did not over the six-year testing period.
links.quote: Covariate drift meaningfully degraded calibration but not discrimination metrics over time.

links.outcome: AUROC and daily bed error after retraining
links.effect: Quarterly and half-yearly retraining improved mean AUROC to 0.892 and 0.893 and reduced bed error to 4.02 and 4.48 beds per day.
links.quote: Retrained models demonstrated improved discrimination (mean AUROC 0.892 and 0.893) and reduced bed error (4.02 and 4.48 beds per day) for quarterly and half-yearly retraining, respectively, with similar calibration and classification performance.

links.outcome: calibration and discrimination performance degradation under covariate drift over time
links.effect: Covariate drift degraded calibration over time but not discrimination; base model had mean AUROC 0.875 (range 0.844-0.887) and mean daily bed error 7.42 beds (range 0.47-13.1).
links.quote: Covariate drift meaningfully degraded calibration but not discrimination metrics over time.
